name: Ingrid Solberg
action: She sets the empty coffee tin on the table and opens her laptop to begin the spreadsheet review, skipping the walk to the bakery.
reason: Ingrid's established pattern of postponing coffee and avoiding interruptions, reinforced by her memory of cleaning racks instead of getting coffee last time and her grandmother's rule against idle talk, leads her to forgo the bakery trip and start her spreadsheet review immediately.
